test_title: SSC CPO 2025 Official Paper (Held On 12 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Who among the following did not receive a Padma award in 2024 for their contribution to Art?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Nithyashree Mahadevan**__.

**__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Padma Awards**, one of the highest civilian honors of India, are announced annually on the eve of **Republic Day**. For the year **2024**, the President approved the conferment of **132 Padma Awards**, including 5 **Padma Vibhushan**, 17 **Padma Bhushan**, and 110 **Padma Shri** awards.
 
• **Vyjayantimala Bali**, a legendary actress and **Bharatanatyam** exponent, was conferred with the **Padma Vibhushan** in the field of **Art** for her exceptional and distinguished service.
 
• **Padma Subrahmanyam**, an acclaimed Indian classical **Bharatanatyam** dancer, choreographer, and music composer, was also awarded the **Padma Vibhushan** in the **Art** category in **2024**.
 
• **Usha Uthup**, the famous Indian pop, jazz, and playback singer known for her unique gravelly voice, received the **Padma Bhushan** in **2024** for her significant contributions to the field of **Art**.
 
• **Nithyashree Mahadevan** is a prominent **Carnatic musician** and playback singer. Although she has received several honors such as the **Kalaimamani** from the Government of Tamil Nadu and various honorary doctorates, she was not a recipient of any **Padma award** in the **2024** list.

 **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Padma Vibhushan** is awarded for 'exceptional and distinguished service', the **Padma Bhushan** for 'distinguished service of high order', and the **Padma Shri** for 'distinguished service' in any field.
 
• **Vyjayantimala Bali**:
 
 
• She was the first female star of **Indian cinema** to be called a 'national heroine'.
 
• She is recognized for introducing 'semi-classical' dance in **Bollywood**.
 
 
 
• **Padma Subrahmanyam**:
 
 
• She is well-known for her research on **Karana** sculptures of Indian temples.
 
• She is the developer of the dance form known as **Bharata Nrithyam**.
 
 
 
• **Usha Uthup**:
 
 
• She has sung in over **15 Indian languages** and several foreign languages.
 
• She began her career in **1969** and became an icon of independent music and stage performance.
 
 
 
• The **Art** category of the Padma awards includes individuals with excellence in **Music**, **Painting**, **Sculpture**, **Photography**, **Cinema**, and **Theatre**.
